plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Sociology, Emphasis of Study, Associate in Art - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/26; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 15/15/15/15 = 60 reconcile exactly. Genuine catalog quirks kept verbatim: 'Associate in Art' (header), 'SOCI 1110 Juvenile Delinquency/Justice'. Course-availability notes from the map: SOCI 1110 is only offered online, but is offered Spring, Summer, and Fall; SOCI 1114 is only offered in the Spring. The map recommends BRTN 1103 and a HLTH or PHED course for the Barton Designated Requirements. To meet the Social & Behavioral Sciences criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSYC, SOCI). To meet the Arts & Humanities criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ARTS, COMM, DANC, ENGL, HIST, LITR, LANG, MUSI, PHIL, RELI, THEA).
